theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The highest-ranked, eligible, non-crowded theme with strong breadth (0.917). The absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) is the only validated edge and favors staying with this theme rather than rotating away on rank alone. Crowding is absent (z=0.78, crowded=false), so no size-down caution applies. This is a durable-leadership read, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Leader themes that are well-known and consensus can underperform as attention is already saturated; the detector's rank-IC is ~0, so leadership provides no forward-return edge and this could simply mark the top of attention.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Challenger to the leader with high durability (0.84) and perfect breadth (1.0), eligible, and a clean trend tag. Crowding is flagged (z=1.88, crowded=true), so this is a size-down caution only, never a fade. The absolute-trend gate keeps it in the eligible set, which is the one validated risk-control signal favoring continuation over rotation.
theses.dissent: High crowding (z=1.88) and attention-spike risk; crowded winners in momentum screens often mean-revert next, and the detector explicitly warns not to treat attention as a buy trigger.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SPY by 8% over the next 20 trading days
